package.name: chase_sim_gz
package.description:
Tier B: Gazebo gz-sim Harmonic lockstep simulation (sim_training_architecture.md section 3). GzChaseEnv steps the world 100 x 1 ms per control period over gz-transport (WorldControl multi-step, completion detected on the unthrottled world clock); tello_sim_shim speaks the Tello stick contract with the driver's 0.35 s dead-man; sim_oracle_detector projects ground truth through OUR camera calibration into chase_msgs/DroneDetection; latency_shim delays it by the measured 150-350 ms on sim time. The world SDF is generated (gen_world.py) with Tello-parameterised multicopter plugins; sign_test.py and calibrate_lag.py implement the mandatory 3.2 protocol (gz yaw-sign issue #2657 is open upstream).
gz-sim Harmonic + ros-humble-ros-gzharmonic install via scripts/install_gz_harmonic.sh (no rosdep keys for the osrf-hosted packages); the FakeGzBackend covers CI without a gz install.
